cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(NativeBitmapGraphReview LANGUAGES NONE)

# This fixture evaluates the production fragment with inert target commands.
# It never loads Foundation, an SDK, a toolkit, an engine or a compiler.
function(r_record name kind)
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY "R_${name}_${kind}" ${ARGN})
endfunction()
function(add_executable name)
    add_library(${name} INTERFACE)
    r_record(${name} SOURCES ${ARGN})
    r_record(all TARGETS ${name})
endfunction()
foreach(command IN ITEMS target_sources target_link_libraries target_include_directories
        target_compile_definitions target_compile_features target_link_options add_dependencies)
    # cmake_language(EVAL) defines wrappers only; their bodies record arguments.
    cmake_language(EVAL CODE "function(${command} name)\n r_record(\"\${name}\" ${command} \${ARGN})\nendfunction()")
endforeach()
function(set_target_properties name)
    r_record(${name} PROPERTIES ${ARGN})
endfunction()
function(foundation_options name)
    r_record(${name} OPTIONS called)
endfunction()
function(install)
    if(NOT ARGV0 STREQUAL "TARGETS")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected inert install form")
    endif()
    r_record(${ARGV1} INSTALL ${ARGV})
endfunction()
function(find_package)
    # Only the actual FLTK helper executes discovery in this fragment. Record
    # its exact request without performing package discovery.
    if(NOT "${ARGV}" STREQUAL "X11;REQUIRED")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected package discovery: ${ARGV}")
    endif()
    r_record(all DISCOVERY ${ARGV})
endfunction()
function(find_program)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Program discovery is forbidden in the inert fixture")
endfunction()
function(enable_language)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Language discovery is forbidden in the inert fixture")
endfunction()
function(execute_process)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Child process execution is forbidden in the inert fixture")
endfunction()
function(r_equal actual expected label)
    if(NOT "${actual}" STREQUAL "${expected}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "${label}: expected [${expected}], observed [${actual}]")
    endif()
    r_record(all ASSERTIONS passed)
endfunction()
function(r_property_equal name kind expected)
    get_property(actual GLOBAL PROPERTY "R_${name}_${kind}")
    r_equal("${actual}" "${expected}" "${name} ${kind}")
endfunction()

set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_PROFILE web)
set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_KERNEL_MAINTENANCE TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_CONSUMER_VERIFIED TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_CONSUMER_VERIFIED TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_ACTIONS_CONSUMER_VERIFIED TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_DOCUMENT_PROFILE pixel)
set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_ACTIONS_PROFILE "")
set(FOUNDATION_GUI_FLTK TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_GUI_SDL TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_GUI_REV TRUE)
set(FOUNDATION_GUI_DISTRIBUTABLE TRUE)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Linux)
set(WIN32 FALSE)
set(MSVC FALSE)
set(EMSCRIPTEN FALSE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR bin)
set(_foundation_native_profile_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/private-profile")
set(_foundation_native_runtime_hint_cpp "../share/software foundation/quoted\\\"/engine-native")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_foundation_native_profile_directory}")
if(NOT REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL missing-header)
    file(WRITE "${_foundation_native_profile_directory}/appended_engine_compiled_native_profile.hpp" "// MOCK ONLY\n")
endif()

foreach(name IN ITEMS foundation_gui_native_surface foundation_appended_native_engine_loader
        foundation_appended_startup foundation_gui_fltk foundation_gui_sdl gui_rev_adapter
        foundation_gui_contract foundation-gui-hosts)
    add_library(${name} INTERFACE)
endforeach()
if(NOT REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL missing-facade)
    add_library(foundation_gui_native_engine_bitmap_composition INTERFACE)
endif()
if(NOT REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL missing-sdl)
    add_library(foundation_gui_native_sdl_surface INTERFACE)
endif()
if(NOT REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL missing-rev)
    add_library(foundation_gui_native_rev_surface INTERFACE)
endif()
add_library(X11::X11 INTERFACE IMPORTED)

if(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL none)
    set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_PROFILE none)
elseif(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL binary)
    set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_PROFILE binary)
elseif(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL wasm)
    set(EMSCRIPTEN TRUE)
elseif(REVIEW_CASE MATCHES "^(linux|windows)-(web|both)-(pixel|actions)$")
    set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_PROFILE "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
    if(CMAKE_MATCH_3 STREQUAL actions)
        set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_DOCUMENT_PROFILE "")
        set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_ACTIONS_PROFILE document-actions-v1)
    endif()
    if(CMAKE_MATCH_1 STREQUAL windows)
        set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Windows)
        set(WIN32 TRUE)
        set(MSVC TRUE)
    endif()
elseif(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL framebuffer-only)
    set(FOUNDATION_GUI_FLTK FALSE)
    set(FOUNDATION_GUI_SDL FALSE)
    set(FOUNDATION_GUI_REV FALSE)
elseif(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL no-install)
    set(FOUNDATION_GUI_DISTRIBUTABLE FALSE)
elseif(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL no-maintenance)
    set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_KERNEL_MAINTENANCE FALSE)
elseif(REVIEW_CASE STREQUAL no-verification)
    set(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_CONSUMER_VERIFIED FALSE)
elseif(NOT REVIEW_CASE MATCHES "^(missing-header|missing-facade|missing-sdl|missing-rev)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown inert fixture case: ${REVIEW_CASE}")
endif()
if(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_PROFILE STREQUAL both)
    add_library(foundation_appended_engine_module_binding INTERFACE)
endif()

include("${REVIEW_BACKENDS}")
include("${REVIEW_FRAGMENT}")

get_property(targets GLOBAL PROPERTY R_all_TARGETS)
if(REVIEW_CASE MATCHES "^(none|binary|wasm)$")
    r_equal("${targets}" "" "ordinary/native-free target absence")
else()
    set(expected foundation-appended-engine-framebuffer)
    if(FOUNDATION_GUI_FLTK)
        list(APPEND expected foundation-appended-engine-fltk)
    endif()
    if(FOUNDATION_GUI_SDL)
        list(APPEND expected foundation-appended-engine-sdl)
    endif()
    if(FOUNDATION_GUI_REV)
        list(APPEND expected foundation-appended-engine-rev)
    endif()
    r_equal("${targets}" "${expected}" "exact selected native target list")
    r_property_equal(foundation-gui-hosts add_dependencies "${expected}")
    foreach(name IN LISTS targets)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^foundation-appended-engine-" "" backend "${name}")
        set(sources "hosts/appended_engine_${backend}_main.cpp")
        r_property_equal(${name} SOURCES "${sources}")
        set(links PRIVATE foundation_gui_native_engine_bitmap_composition foundation_gui_native_surface
            foundation_appended_native_engine_loader foundation_appended_startup)
        set(definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_PROFILE_ENABLED=1
            "FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_RUNTIME_HINT=\"${_foundation_native_runtime_hint_cpp}\"")
        if(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_ACTIONS_PROFILE)
            list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_DOCUMENT_ACTIONS_PROFILE=1)
        else()
            list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_APPENDED_ENGINE_NATIVE_DOCUMENT_ACTIONS_PROFILE=0)
        endif()
        if(FOUNDATION_APPENDED_PROFILE STREQUAL both)
            list(APPEND links PRIVATE foundation_appended_engine_module_binding)
            list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_APPENDED_BINARY_CAPABILITY=1)
        else()
            list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_APPENDED_BINARY_CAPABILITY=0)
        endif()
        if(backend STREQUAL fltk)
            list(APPEND links PRIVATE foundation_gui_fltk foundation_gui_native_surface)
            if(WIN32)
                list(APPEND links PRIVATE imm32 user32)
            else()
                list(APPEND links PRIVATE X11::X11)
            endif()
        elseif(backend STREQUAL sdl)
            list(APPEND links PRIVATE foundation_gui_native_sdl_surface foundation_gui_sdl)
        elseif(backend STREQUAL rev)
            list(APPEND links PRIVATE foundation_gui_native_rev_surface gui_rev_adapter)
        endif()
        set(properties PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
        if(WIN32)
            list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE main=foundation_gui_main SDL_MAIN_HANDLED)
            list(APPEND links PRIVATE shell32)
            if(backend STREQUAL framebuffer)
                list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_NATIVE_BITMAP_CONSOLE_ENTRY=1)
            else()
                set(properties PROPERTIES WIN32_EXECUTABLE TRUE PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
            endif()
            if(backend STREQUAL sdl)
                list(APPEND definitions PRIVATE FOUNDATION_GUI_SDL_ENTRY)
            endif()
            r_property_equal(${name} target_sources "PRIVATE;hosts/appended_engine_windows_entry.cpp")
            r_property_equal(${name} target_link_options "PRIVATE;/MANIFEST:EMBED;/MANIFESTINPUT:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hosts/windows_gui.manifest")
        else()
            r_property_equal(${name} target_sources "")
            r_property_equal(${name} target_link_options "")
        endif()
        r_property_equal(${name} target_link_libraries "${links}")
        r_property_equal(${name} target_compile_definitions "${definitions}")
        r_property_equal(${name} target_include_directories "PRIVATE;${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR};${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR};${_foundation_native_profile_directory};${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/abi/appended")
        r_property_equal(${name} target_compile_features "PRIVATE;cxx_std_20")
        r_property_equal(${name} PROPERTIES "${properties}")
        r_property_equal(${name} add_dependencies foundation_gui_contract)
        r_property_equal(${name} OPTIONS called)
        if(FOUNDATION_GUI_DISTRIBUTABLE)
            r_property_equal(${name} INSTALL "TARGETS;${name};RUNTIME;DESTINATION;bin")
        else()
            r_property_equal(${name} INSTALL "")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(FOUNDATION_GUI_FLTK AND NOT WIN32)
        r_property_equal(all DISCOVERY "X11;REQUIRED")
    else()
        r_property_equal(all DISCOVERY "")
    endif()
endif()
get_property(assertions GLOBAL PROPERTY R_all_ASSERTIONS)
list(LENGTH assertions count)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ASSERTIONS.txt" "${count}\n")
message(STATUS "Native bitmap inert graph assertions: ${count}")
